headline: Gold and silver unchanged today; gold up about 3.4% over the past week
summary: Today's national average rates show no change from the previous rate: 24K gold is ₹14,357 per gram and silver is ₹2,05,000 per kg. Over the last 7 days, 24K gold has risen ₹469 (3.38%) and silver has risen ₹5,000 (2.5%), while over the 14 days in our data silver is down 6.82% from its ₹2,20,000 level on 26 October. Likely drivers include movements in the US dollar against the rupee and international gold prices, though today's flat reading reflects no new change in the rate.
outlook: With today's rates flat and gold having moved up this week, buyers may compare prices across a few jewellers before purchasing, and should note that GST and making charges sit on top of these rates.
